sources.entry: SaneClick - Finder extension with 51+ right-click actions for file management, image conversion, and developer tools.

summary.one_liner: SaneClick is a macOS Finder extension that adds 62 ready-made right-click actions (copy paths, image conversion, OCR, PDF merge, hashing, archives, and more) plus support for user-written Bash, AppleScript, or Automator actions.
summary.what_it_does: The app installs a Finder Sync extension that adds a context menu with actions you toggle on from a built-in library of 62 pre-built actions organized into categories (Essentials, Files & Folders, Images & Media, Coding, Advanced). Actions appear only for matching file types, and can be filtered by selection count (single or multi-select) and by whether any or all files match. Users can write custom actions in Bash, AppleScript, or Automator, test them on real files with output preview, and import/export scripts as JSON. The README states that file contents are processed locally and not uploaded; update and license checks use limited network requests described in PRIVACY.md. A menu bar icon offers quick settings, Finder restart, and updates, and a status indicator shows whether the extension is active.
use_cases: Convert or resize images from right-click
Extract text from images with OCR
Open a folder in Terminal from Finder
Create custom right-click scripts without Automator knowledge
notable: 62 pre-built Finder context menu actions toggled on or off from a library
Custom actions in Bash, AppleScript, or Automator with test-before-save preview
Selection count and extension match filtering for when actions appear
Import/export of scripts as JSON with skip or replace duplicate handling
Color-coded extension status badge with one-click Finder restart
caveats: Apple Silicon (arm64) only and requires macOS 14.0 or later
Free 14-day trial, then a one-time $14.99 purchase is needed to keep using the app
Building from source requires Xcode 16 and XcodeGen
